propositions: rebar review CLI verb is superseded by review-plan gate and must be retired via a loud deprecation shim that rejects incompatible arguments (--graph, positional reviewer_id) with exit code 2 and error messages naming the replacement
The deprecation shim must preserve read-only semantics by unconditionally forwarding --no-sign to review-plan, so a bare rebar review <id> writes no attestation, exactly as before

Three deprecation registry rows (cli:rebar review, lib:rebar.llm.review_ticket, mcp:review_ticket) must be added as scheduled supersessions scheduled for removal in v1.0.0, with no emission site bypassing warn_deprecated()

The public library function review_ticket must split into private _review_ticket_impl (called by MCP tool, diff harness, eval harness) and public facade that emits lib deprecation warning, so a single MCP invocation emits exactly one deprecation signal
OUTPUT_SCHEMAS['review'] must be repointed to PLAN_REVIEW_VERDICT (matching the shim's output), and REVIEW_RESULT re-wired under synthetic 'review_ticket' key for the surviving library/MCP surface

A non-claimable ticket (closed/blocked/idea) must fast-fail with exit 2 and no LLM call, diverging from the old verb's model invocation; this divergence is documented in help text and tested explicitly
